criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1 is the strongest frame, the part's pockets under the spindle and the type in the dark head housing, though the vise is a plain block, the chips flat C rings and a blue-white sliver shows behind the vise handle. 6 works: 24 cyan outlines beside the 100. 9 is a real close with a person at true scale in the taped bays, near pads matte and windows flat. 4 is better than round 1 with the pool on the machinist, but its blue-lit panels read as a data hall aisle and the lower 35 percent is empty floor. Four frames lean on a default. 3 reads as a keyboard or grille at 432 px with a 50 px lifted part. 8 is a rounded slab with 36 calculator keys on a navy field, the knobs under the footer and the arm's post under 'cell.'. 2 reads as graph paper, the pour mid grey and the rolled corner a thin fold. 7 is a flat cyanotype viewed straight down with a hard polygon cast. No frame passes the showstopper test, none is a decorated template.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dark machine-shop world, one cyan accent for Hadrian's cell on 6, 7 and 9, medians 12.4, 1.7 and 8.2 on 1, 6 and 9 with nothing strobing. The 5 to 6 hold and the part motif do real work and the cut at 6 is the turn. 8's navy field belongs to no other frame, and the light wanders: casts right on 2 and 7, up-right on 5 and 6, an overhead pool on 4.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide numeral traces to figures.json and the drawn counts follow them (312, 10 by 10, 24), and the squares on 2 measure as the square roots of 100k and 85k over 735k. Sources are primary and Dallas County comes from TDLR. The deck avoids the traps its claims file lists. On 7 'Hadrian, on its own factories' narrows c20 past what it says, which is conservative and does not change what a reader believes about this cell, so it is the 7 descriptor, not a hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader learns what happened and where. The decision is corporate, with no public body, deadline or action for a Texan. The stake is the open question on 8, honest but abstract, and the concrete stakes appear only as caveats on 3 and 9.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover is a plain announcement, 2 pays at once with a measured scale, the turn at 6 is set up by holding 5 still, 8 asks the question and 9 closes on who runs it. 3 and 4 could move or merge without loss.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, and the caption opener is sharp. Slide copy turns procedural on 3 and 5, and 'Drawn to illustrate.' closes all nine deks. Texas presence is limited to Grand Prairie and Dallas County.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The subject is new against nos. 53 to 55. The recipe is familiar: the lastLight world again, relief and spatial frames mixed, a dark field with one cold accent, an object close-up cover.

one_sentence_fix: Re-shoot frame 3 with the empty pocket and the lifted part large in the foreground pool, and rebuild frame 8's pendant at full detail against the graphite enclosure instead of the navy field.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 312 identical parts read as a keyboard texture at 432 px, the lifted part about 50 px with no pull, the second tray fading into a grey band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Put the empty pocket and the lifted part in the foreground at 300 px or more with a long cast across the bench, and delete the second tray.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive rounded slab with 36 calculator keys on a saturated navy field, the knobs under the footer and the arm's post under 'cell.'.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Replace the navy with the graphite enclosure falling to black, model recessed keys and a knurled handwheel raked from the left, raise the crop so the knobs clear the footer and drop the arm below the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A regular saw-cut grid reads as graph paper in the grey middle, the pour mid grey, the rolled corner a thin fold.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the joints to two or three wide saw cuts on near-black concrete, light the pour as the one bright surface and model the carpet corner as a rolled cylinder 30 to 40 px high.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat UI mockup seen straight down, a hard polygon cast, the lower bands thin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Stand the part in depth with a soft long cast across the linework and run the sheet off the bottom and right edges.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Dominoes at a sheared oblique, the right 40 percent empty black.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lay a faint unmarked pool of the low key on the empty floor and lengthen the stack-pole casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blue-lit panels read as a server aisle and the lower 35 percent is empty floor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn the near machine's door window warm and lit from inside with the part visible, and drop the camera about 0.4 m.
